title: 第9章 突破炼气四层第10章 太乙精金
lines: 自从紫阳坊市回到宗门后，李卓阳便待在杂货铺，整日修炼。
他这次得了上千块灵石，一时不缺修炼资源，自然不敢浪费时间。
毕竟韩盈盈已经炼气九层圆满了，若真是让她筑基成功，那以后见了面，岂不是要称呼一声韩师叔？
虽然李卓阳相信韩盈盈对自己的情感绝不会改变，但修仙界就是实力为尊，修为低就要自居晚辈。
李卓阳想到这个画面，都觉得有些不敢想象。
因为李卓阳在吸收灵石时，丹田气海存储很少，大部分灵气都会沿着经脉散溢到周深气穴中，导致肌肤时常处于即将爆裂的边缘。
所以以往每天都不敢过多吸收灵石。
但这次自从开始饮用灵江茶水后，他的肉身承受灵气的能力似乎强了不少。
而且，在察觉到肉体即将爆裂时，一杯灵茶入腹后，茶叶中蕴含的独特灵气便会将肉体上的微小伤痕迅速抚平，且肌肉会得到一丝丝强化。
这龙江灵茶的确是炼体士绝佳的辅修材料，可惜这世上炼体士已经越来越少了。
时间过得很快，转眼半个月就过去了，李卓阳的千余颗灵石已经用去了一小半儿。
这日，李卓阳手握两颗灵石端坐在蒲团上，身边一壶灵茶袅袅地飘着一缕白烟。
“咔嚓……咔嚓……”
随着两声清脆的碎裂声，李卓阳紧闭的双眼终于打开了。
脸上也露出了久违的笑容。
炼气四层，终于突破了！
困扰他两年多的炼气期第一个小壁垒，终于被他攻克了！
这当中当然少不了龙江灵茶的功劳，但是他夜以继日的修炼，才是突破的最主要因素。
李卓阳欣喜之余，并未着急起身，而是仔细感受自身的变化。
突破炼气四层带来的最大改变就是丹田气海的大小。
如今他的气海比之三层时，大了有将近一倍，而且更加坚固。
这意味着，李卓阳丹田内能随时调用的灵气，比之之前有了几倍的增长。
除了丹田气海外，周深的气穴中，由灵气凝聚的小小气旋，也在缓缓地旋转着。
这些小气旋虽然大小上看似没有什么改变，但李卓阳能感知这些气旋似乎更加紧实了。
另外，自己的神识似乎也得到了加强，此时他再沟通玄天宝鉴甄别宝物时，似乎比之之前快上了一丝丝。
李卓阳将心中的欣喜按下，然后又打坐了一日，等修为彻底巩固后，方站起了身子。
此次修炼半个月有余，也该出来活动活动了。
毕竟自己和许家有了两百颗紫阳石的约定，第一次交易可不能食言了。
收拾一番，李卓阳便出了宗门，朝紫阳矿区赶去。
到了接近中午时，李卓阳方才赶到矿区，他买飞行法器的念头更加迫切了。
进了矿区，李卓阳仍是先领了矿铲，进入了一处矿洞。
尽管不一定能挖得到紫阳石，但来都来了……
矿洞内，李卓阳正走着，忽然想起，此时直接链接玄天宝鉴，是不是可以将洞内的紫阳石都给找出来？
content_en:
Since returning to the sect from Ziyangfang City, Li Zhuoyang has stayed in the grocery store and practiced all day long.
He had obtained thousands of spiritual stones this time and had no shortage of cultivation resources, so he naturally did not dare to waste time.
After all, Han Yingying has completed the ninth level of Qi refining. If she really succeeds in building the foundation, wouldn't she have to call her Master Han when we meet in the future?
Although Li Zhuoyang believed that Han Yingying's feelings for him would never change, in the world of immortality, strength is respected, and those with low cultivation would consider themselves juniors.
When Li Zhuoyang thought about this scene, he felt a little unimaginable.
Because when Li Zhuoyang absorbed the spirit stone, there was very little Qi stored in his Dantian, and most of the Spiritual Qi would spread along the meridians into the Zhou Shen Qi points, causing his skin to always be on the verge of bursting.
Therefore, I didn’t dare to absorb too many spiritual stones every day.
But this time since he started drinking Lingjiang tea, his physical body's ability to withstand spiritual energy seems to have become much stronger.
Moreover, when you feel that your body is about to explode, after taking a cup of spiritual tea, the unique spiritual energy contained in the tea will quickly heal the tiny scars on your body, and your muscles will be strengthened.
This Longjiang Lingcha is indeed an excellent supplementary training material for body refiners. Unfortunately, there are fewer and fewer body refiners in this world.
Time passed quickly, half a month passed in the blink of an eye, and Li Zhuoyang had used less than half of his more than a thousand spiritual stones.
On this day, Li Zhuoyang sat on the futon with two spiritual stones in his hands, and a wisp of white smoke floated from a pot of spiritual tea beside him.
"Click... click..."
With two crisp cracking sounds, Li Zhuoyang's closed eyes finally opened.
A long-lost smile appeared on his face.
The fourth level of Qi refining was finally broken through!
The first small barrier in the Qi refining period that had troubled him for more than two years was finally overcome by him!
Of course, the contribution of Longjiang Lingcha was indispensable, but his day and night practice was the most important factor in the breakthrough.
Although Li Zhuoyang was overjoyed, he did not get up in a hurry, but carefully felt the changes in himself.
The biggest change brought about by breaking through the fourth level of Qi refining is the size of the Dantian Qi sea.
Now his Qi Hai is nearly twice as big as when it was at level three, and it's even stronger.
This means that the spiritual energy that can be called upon at any time in Li Zhuoyang's Dantian has increased several times compared to before.
In addition to the Qi in Dantian, a small cyclone condensed by spiritual energy in Zhou Shen's air caves was also slowly rotating.
Although these small cyclones seemed to have remained the same in size, Li Zhuoyang could feel that these cyclones seemed to be more compact.
In addition, his spiritual consciousness seemed to have been strengthened. At this time, when he communicated with Xuantian Baojian to identify treasures, he seemed to be slightly faster than before.
Li Zhuoyang suppressed the joy in his heart, and then meditated for another day. After his cultivation was completely consolidated, he stood up.
This time I have been practicing for more than half a month, and it’s time to get out and do some activities.
After all, he and the Xu family had made an agreement for two hundred purple sun stones, and he couldn't break his promise on the first transaction.
After cleaning up, Li Zhuoyang left the sect and rushed towards the Ziyang mining area.
It was close to noon when Li Zhuoyang arrived at the mining area, and his desire to buy a flying magic weapon became even more urgent.
After entering the mining area, Li Zhuoyang took the mining shovel first and entered a mine cave.
Although you may not be able to dig up Ziyang Stone, you can come here...
In the mine, Li Zhuoyang was walking when he suddenly remembered that by directly connecting to the Xuantian Treasure Mirror, could he find all the Purple Sunstones in the cave?
